title: Niagara Falls Small Walking Tour Panoramic view and Boat ride

blurb:
Experience Niagara Falls like a local with a professional photographer as your guide! This exclusive small-group combo saves you time and stress by including pre-reserved tickets to the Skylon Tower for 360-degree views and entry to the iconic Niagara City Cruises boat tour.

As we walk through the most scenic spots in a small, intimate group, I will share the fascinating history of the area and capture your best moments with a professional photo included in your package. This bilingual tour is specially designed for small groups to ensure a personal and unforgettable experience.
